text:
Evan: Starting Compass cohort planning thread — objective: fast feedback on inference tuning and rollout gating. Need agreement on recruitment, signals, and what to do if we hit perf surprises.
Sofia: Proposal: 9 orgs, 8 weeks, staggered starts in two waves. Keep scope: chat + embeddings. No tool-calling until after week 3.
Mei: Ops/Infra: For hosted we can allocate a small reserved pool, but VPC installs (we should allow up to 2) require peering + KMS check. Add 5 business days for VPC prep.
Carlos: From CS: recruit 4 existing product teams + 5 new prospects. Offer a $2k bill-credit or equivalent gift for active participation. Ask them to nominate 3 power users each.
Sofia: Success metrics draft: - Engagement: >=50% weekly active power users - Perf: p95 < 275ms on typical 2-turn dialogue - Quality: no >12% drop on golden prompts - Econ: per-token cost <= 85% of baseline
Evan: Instrumentation requirements: pilot_id and org_id headers, and a pilot flag in logs. Short header example: `X-Pilot-Id: compass-1`
Mei: Also add an event for fallback triggers (when we switch to a cheaper quantized variant). We'll surface those in the console.
Carlos: Recruitment plan: CS/AM to nominate by Wed, then outreach email + 20min kickoff call. Incentive paid after completing two monthly interviews and weekly pulses.
Sofia: Launch gates: 1) infra reservation confirmed, 2) tagging implemented and verified, 3) onboarding security checklist accepted, 4) two internal smoke runs.
Evan: Exit criteria: cohort considered successful if it meets engagement + perf + econ thresholds and >=3 orgs request follow-on pilot or contract.
Mei: If a customer shows poor engagement by week 3, schedule a pairing session with product engineer; if perf spikes persist, enable automatic fallback and notify customer.
Carlos: Action items: - Evan: draft invite + metric doc by Fri - Sofia: shortlist 15 candidates and pick 9 by Thu - Mei: push tagging + fallback telemetry by Wed - Carlos: prepare outreach templates and incentives by Thu
DeployBot: infra-bot: Please open ticket INFRA-COMPASS-001 to reserve capacity and tag required windows.
Evan: I'll create the shared timeline doc after this thread. Quick thumbs if this plan looks good. :thumbsup:
